I was yelled at by a female dentist, and she used an instrument to poke my mouth. I understand that I shouldn't move my tongue during dental work, but my body naturally twitched as much as it could. The dentist should have understood that and shouldn't have acted that way. I believe that if she had kept my mouth open for that long, she would have experienced the same symptoms as anyone else. I understand that her job is difficult, and I did my best, but she should have understood my perspective too. She can scold me, but poking my mouth with an instrument like that is unacceptable. I paid tens of thousands of baht for good service, and I'm very disappointed.
